description: This file defines the Affiliate controller class within the OpenCart e-commerce platform, specifically for handling API requests related to affiliates. It processes input data, loads models and language resources, retrieves affiliate information, and manages the session state.

classes.name: Affiliate
classes.description: Controller class for API interactions related to affiliates in OpenCart, extending the core Controller class.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main method that handles the API request. Loads language, retrieves affiliate ID and order subtotal, verifies affiliate existence, and sets session data and output accordingly.
